claims.description: Inherited `font-family` and supported `font-size` units feed deterministic text measurement.

notes.text: Nested text inherits parent font metrics; `inherit`, `unset`, and `initial` are accepted where supported. Percentage and `em` sizes resolve against the inherited parent size, while `rem` resolves against the computed root size.

claims.description: Inherited font weight and letter spacing contribute to configured and default text measurement.

notes.text: Parity covers inherited numeric font weight and positive pixel letter spacing with the deterministic parity font.
Relative `bolder` and `lighter` weights and the full browser font-selection algorithm are not modeled.

claims.description: Inherited case transforms are applied before intrinsic text measurement without changing DOM text content.

notes.text: The transformed string feeds default and custom text measurement while `textContent` retains the authored string.
Full-width and full-size-kana transforms and locale-specific case mapping are not modeled.

claims.description: Supported `line-height` values determine measured line boxes.

notes.text: The engine does not preserve the browser distinction between inherited numeric and resolved `line-height` values.

claims.description: Initial supported `@font-face` sources provide deterministic glyph advances and kerning.

notes.text: Attachment discovers initial document, adopted, and configured stylesheet font faces, selects the first registered family and closest numeric weight, and uses glyph advances plus kerning for intrinsic measurement.
Dynamic font-face insertion, `local()` lookup, WOFF2, variable axes, and complex-script shaping are not modeled. Unavailable or unmatched fonts retain deterministic fallback measurement.

claims.description: Supported `white-space` modes control text preservation and wrapping.

notes.text: Text-only leaf elements and direct text-plus-`br` leaves are measured through the configured `TextMeasurer`; the default attachment path uses discovered font data with deterministic fallback.

claims.description: Inline text runs contribute line boxes alongside block children in a shared container.

notes.text: Parity covers an inline phrasing run after a block child, including the run's contribution to parent flow height and its element rectangle.
The engine does not implement the full inline formatting model.
